items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: But we started it. Buck and Bubbles started that and we were the first three Ink Spots... They became famous by the name of the Ink Spots. Deek Watts was from Indianapolis... they had Deek Watson, they had Bill Kenny and two other boys

ctx.x: famous by the name of the Ink Spots. Deek Watts was from Indianapolis and I don't know where the other boys were from. But they had Deek Watson, they had Bill Kenny and two other boys from time to time, they'd take one out and put one in. However, they made a big name out of the Ink Spots, you know. But we started it. Buck and Bubbles started that and we were the first three Ink Spots and that was about the year of 1914 -'15 -- '14 I think it was, 1914, something like that. It could have been a little later. But…
When you first established the Ink Spots what kind of things did you do together?
